Category.description: A folder for links. Categories nest: a category with a parentId is a subcategory of that parent, to any depth.

Link.description: A saved web link. A link can be a parent link whose notes hold related sub-links.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Unique across all links.

notes.description: Rich text notes (an HTML fragment), e.g. related sub-links under a parent link. The server sanitizes it: allowed tags p, br, strong, b, em, i, u, s, code, pre, blockquote, h3, h4, ul, ol, li, a, hr; the only attribute is href on a (http, https or mailto), and every a gets target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer". Notes with no text and no links are stored as null.

categoryId.description: Category or subcategory the link is filed in. null means unsorted.
